description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Earth with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Earth] and [Spellblade Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Earth
description.text: Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =50%/75%/100% for equipped Spellblade abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Spellblade abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Earth], grants [Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry Mode 2]/[Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry Mode] if 0-3/4+ FF5 allies are alive, removes [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode I: Bartz - Earth]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Earth
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Spellblade abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Spellblade abilities trigger 1 additional time, critical chance =100%

description.name: Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry Mode 2
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Spellblade abilities, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Earth]

description.name: Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry Mode
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient), casts Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry after using a Spellblade ability, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Spellblade Mode II: Bartz - Earth]

description.name: Dual Spellblade Earth Flurry
description.text: Five single attacks (0.59 each), 100% hit rate

description.name: Attach Earth with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3
